rules.basis: The Freedom sheets state the continuous output at 40 °C, in watts, with the temperature in the name.
The Freedom SW sheet states the AC output as 230 V; the rule reads that sheet only, since the Freedom XC manuals print a status screen's reading under the same name.
The MS2000 and RS3000 manuals state 'AC Output' as 120 V in their specification tables.

The Freedom XC manuals list the selectable output voltages, '120, 110, 108 VAC', which the parser refuses as a list, so the figure is named and the gap says so rather than publishing one displayed voltage as the set.
The PROwatt and Freedom sheets state 'Nominal Voltage' as 12 V under the DC input, the battery's.

The Freedom SW and EX sheets state the charger's output in amps, 65 to 90 A, the SW's continuous at 25 °C, which the figure keeps; the C-series controller sheets state the charging or load current rating at 25 °C, 35 to 60 A. The Freedom XC manuals' 'Charging current' is a display reading on a status page, 30 A where the sheet rates the charger at 80 A, and is not read.
The Freedom XC sheet states 'Recommended battery capacity' as one figure, 100 Ah; the Freedom XC 1800's '100 Ah or more' is a bound and stays unread.
